mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalBooks, SUM(CASE WHEN book_status = #{serializingCode} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS serializingBooks, SUM(CASE WHEN book_status = #{finishedCode} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishedBooks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = #{onShelfCode} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onShelfBooks, SUM(CASE WHEN status = #{bannedCode} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bannedBooks, COALESCE(SUM(word_count), 0) AS totalWords FROM book_info
